text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

- Rosenborg are the best team in the Nordic region after beating Sweden's Gothenburg 3-2 in a European Cup Champions' League Group D first round game. Rosenborg played very well in the second half and Gothenburg panicked.
- The national audit office is worried that controls of the state's oil wealth may be inadequate.
- It is possible that Lebanon will demand the extradition of the Palestinian man who hijacked a Bulgarian plane to Oslo last week.

- The country's municipalities will receive 2.5 billion crowns more in tax income for 1996 than the government forecast in the final state budget for the year. The reason for the increase is that the Norwegian economy is doing well.
- An engineer was sentenced to four years in prison for stealing technology from industrial group Norsk Hydro ASA and selling it to companies abroad.
- Another Statoil AS employee has been taken in for questioning in the Idavoll corruption case.
